description: This file defines the OctoClient class, which serves as the client interface to server APIs for a web application, handling operations such as user authentication, board and block management, file uploads, and other server interactions.

classes.name: OctoClient
classes.description: A client class providing methods to interact with server APIs for user management, board and block operations, file handling, and other functionalities.

methods.name: getBaseURL
methods.description: Returns the base URL for API requests, dynamically determined at runtime.

methods.name: token
methods.description: Getter and setter for the session token stored in localStorage.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login with username and password, stores session token.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user and clears session token.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with email, username, and password.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Changes password for a specified user.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Constructs headers for API requests, including authorization.

methods.name: teamPath
methods.description: Constructs API path for team-specific endpoints.

methods.name: teamsPath
methods.description: Returns API path for teams list.

methods.name: getMyBoardMemberships
methods.description: Fetches boards the user is a member of.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Fetches user info by user ID.

methods.name: getUsersList
methods.description: Fetches list of users by user IDs.

methods.name: exportBoardArchive
methods.description: Exports archive of a specific board.

methods.name: exportFullArchive
methods.description: Exports full archive for a team.

methods.name: importFullArchive
methods.description: Imports full archive from a file.

methods.name: getBlocksWithParent
methods.description: Fetches blocks with a specific parent ID.

methods.name: getBlocksWithType
methods.description: Fetches blocks of a specific type.

methods.name: getBlocksWithBlockID
methods.description: Fetches blocks by block ID within a board.

methods.name: getAllBlocks
methods.description: Fetches all blocks within a board.

methods.name: followBlock
methods.description: Subscribes a user to a block.

methods.name: unfollowBlock
methods.description: Unsubscribes a user from a block.

methods.name: getSharing
methods.description: Retrieves sharing settings for a board.

methods.name: setSharing
methods.description: Sets sharing settings for a board.

methods.name: uploadFile
methods.description: Uploads a file and returns its ID.

methods.name: uploadAttachment
methods.description: Uploads a file as an attachment.

methods.name: getFileAsDataUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a file as a data URL.

methods.name: getTeamUsersList
methods.description: Fetches list of users by IDs in a team.

methods.name: reorderSidebarCategoryBoards
methods.description: Reorders boards within a sidebar category.

methods.name: moveBoardToCategory
methods.description: Moves a board to a different category.

methods.name: searchLinkableBoards
methods.description: Searches linkable boards within a team.

methods.name: moveBlockTo
methods.description: Moves a block before or after another block.

methods.name: hideBoard
methods.description: Hides a board in a category.

methods.name: unhideBoard
methods.description: Unhides a board in a category.
